I should have immediately used "ortid" to open the "wardrobe" and "bed" instead of guessing "open," and used "enerk" to move between rooms instead of "go to." Furthermore, I need to recognize that "put" might not be the correct verb; I should try "alism" to place items. My new strategy is to strictly use the allowed verbs "ortid," "enerk," and "alism" with the correct nouns "wardrobe," "bed," "kitchen," "ceoust," "plate," "thot," and "penol" to solve the puzzle.
